title: Schema for the maps data file: every mission's map (campaign, skirmish, four-player, raid)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

name.description: Map name (a campaign map is named after its mission)

image.description: The file path for this map's image

hidden_images.description: The parts of the map revealed during its mission, an image each in the order the mission reveals them (empty for a map shown whole)
